source: castle in the sky on a island that connects to other Islands with a bridge. And vines hanging down underneath with the other Islands, with housing, like villages and farms and swimming areas with trees and jungles. Twenty maximum of islands

image_prompt.text: The sky castle on the central island, visible from every other island in the archipelago
Bridges spanning island to island, giving the archipelago an obvious grain of movement
Composed vantage points looking out across the islands and down past the hanging vines
Up to twenty floating islands scattered around the central castle island
Thick vines hanging down from the undersides of the islands
Village housing clustered on the smaller islands
Cultivated farm plots on the smaller islands
Open water for swimming, bordered by trees
Dense jungle foliage and trees across the islands

notes: Stacked verticality routes P2: the islands float with vines and open air beneath them, which is overhang by definition.
No theme was stated — a castle and jungle villages could be read fantasy or stylized, and the file says not to guess.
Village housing is carried as free text rather than building-interior, because nothing says players go inside and promoting it would buy P3 the user never asked for.
